title: A theme page starts a Space already wearing the theme: Space creation reads ?theme= and applies it
detail: /spaces/new?theme=<id> (ids from MEGA_THEMES) is read by the page, carried by the Wizard as arrivedTheme, and createSpace calls applyMegaTheme once the Space exists. An unknown id does nothing and cannot 404; a failed apply is logged and never blocks the Space. The kit pages at /themes/<id> link here with ?theme= and, for a starter kit, ?niche= as well.

verify.evidence: Probe passes; render test pins the kit-page links.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const f=require("fs");const r=(p)=>f.readFileSync(p,"utf8");if(!r("lib/spaces/provision.ts").includes("applyMegaTheme")){console.error("createSpace no longer applies the theme");process.exit(1)};if(!r("app/(main)/spaces/new/page.tsx").includes("arrivedTheme")){console.error("page no longer reads ?theme=");process.exit(1)}'
